cassia.predicted_cell_type: Mixed/ambiguous: capillary/BBB endothelial cell + deep-layer (L5/6) excitatory neuron, with mural/pericyte contamination
strengths: Correctly detected multiple mutually exclusive lineage programs (endothelial, deep-layer excitatory neuron, mural/pericyte) in the DEG list.
Appropriately treated weak immune/ciliary markers as secondary/contamination.
Recommended doublet/QC checks before single-label assignment.
weaknesses: No single primary cell type; mixed label cannot serve as a clean annotation.
Over-indexed on the endothelial program (ERG, SLC5A8) despite the larger neuronal marker block.

strengths: Correctly identified the dominant neuronal lineage (SYT2, VAT1L, CHST8, BCL11B, NEFH, SCN4B, KCNN2, HTR7).
weaknesses: Under-specific: neuron/cortical neuron is an ancestor of the supported glutamatergic neuron label.
Ignored glutamatergic-specific evidence (GRM8, BCL11B layer 5/6) and the vascular/mural contamination signals.

strengths: Added glutamatergic specificity supported by GRM8 (glutamate receptor) and BCL11B (layer 5/6 projection neuron marker).
Correctly ruled out GABAergic identity by absence of GAD1/SST/PVALB.
Hierarchically consistent with in-house neuron label; most specific ontology-valid descendant.
weaknesses: Did not address the endothelial/BBB and mural/pericyte contamination programs in the same cluster.
Layer/area specificity (L5/6, DLPFC) not fully captured by CL:0000679.

supporting: Neuronal identity: SYT2, VAT1L, CHST8, ATP10A, NEFH, SCN4B, KCNN2, HTR7, SPHKAP in top DEGs.
Glutamatergic/excitatory identity: GRM8 (glutamate receptor), BCL11B (layer 5/6 excitatory projection neuron marker), plus absence of GABAergic markers GAD1/SST/PVALB (PMID 29276055).
No inhibitory neuron markers (GAD1, SST, PVALB) support the glutamatergic over GABAergic branch.
conflicting: Endothelial/BBB program: ERG, SLC5A8, SLC47A1, ADTRP, NRP1, TEC and vascular enrichment terms (Tie2 Signaling, Neurophilin interactions with VEGF/VEGFR, Cell surface interactions at the vascular wall).
Mural/pericyte/ECM program: ADRA1A, ANGPT1, PAPPA, COL24A1, COL21A1, VWA5A, NPNT.
enrichment_or_literature: Vascular Reactome terms (Tie2 Signaling, Organic anion transporters) reflect ambient vascular contamination rather than the primary identity.
PMID 29276055 used as brain cell-type marker reference for BCL11B/GRM8 interpretation.

provenance.note: Publication-facing final decision, QC disposition and evaluation fields are synchronized to the submitted Supplementary Data.
